jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (React & Node.js)
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Full Stack Engineer to lead architecture on our cloud applications. You will design resilient APIs, build high-performance React frontends, and collaborate with product teams on high-impact scalable services.

Requirements:
- 5+ years of experience with React, TypeScript/JavaScript, and Node.js.
- Strong understanding of REST APIs, database schemas, and microservices.
- Experience with cloud infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines.
- Passion for clean architecture, automated testing, and developer experience.

jobs.title: Lead AI / ML Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
Lead the next generation of AI-driven recruiting and enterprise productivity intelligence. In this role, you will architect multimodal LLM pipelines, implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) frameworks, and deploy secure enterprise AI workflows.

Requirements:
- Deep expertise in foundation models, Gemini API, PyTorch, or Hugging Face.
- Experience deploying scalable LLM systems in production.
- Proven background in software engineering and distributed computing.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer (Design Systems)
jobs.description:
Join our design team to craft state-of-the-art user experiences for enterprise workflow products. You will maintain our design system, facilitate user research, and build interactive prototypes.

Requirements:
- Proven portfolio showcasing high-fidelity UI/UX design and design tokens.
- Mastery of Figma, component architecture, and accessibility (WCAG AA).
- Strong communication skills and cross-functional leadership.

applications.name: Andrei Reginald C. Co
applications.role: Computer Science Undergraduate Specializing in Data Science
applications.experienceSummary: Computer Science undergraduate specializing in Data Science at UST, with practical experience in end-to-end NLP pipelines, desktop/mobile app development, and data governance.
applications.resumeText:
ANDREI REGINALD C. CO
Sta. Mesa, Manila, Philippines | (+63) 943-744-0155 | andreireginaldc.co@gmail.com | https://github.com/arg-nld

SUMMARY
Computer Science undergraduate specializing in Data Science at UST. Experienced in end-to-end NLP pipelines, desktop/mobile app development, and currently interning in UnionBank's Transformation Strategy & Data Governance Group. Dedicated to delivering robust and scalable data-driven solutions.

TECHNICAL SKILLS
Languages:
Python, Java, SQL, JavaScript, Dart
Web & Mobile:
HTML, CSS, Flutter
Data Science & Analytics:
Pandas, NumPy, Power Bi, Tableau, SAS, SQLite, Excel (Pivot Tables)
Tools:
Figma, Canva, Git, Collate

EDUCATION
University of Santo Tomas
BS in Computer Science
Specialization: Data Science
Aug 2023 – June 2026

CERTIFICATIONS
• Professor Widoms Data Science Workshop (DLSU, 2024)
• Responsive Web Design (FreeCodeCamp, 2023)

SPOKEN LANGUAGES
English (Fluent)
Mandarin (Proficient/Fluent)
Hokkien (Fluent)
Filipino (Native)

EXPERIENCE
UnionBank | Transformation Strategy & Data Governance Intern
Feb 2026 – May 2026
• Contributing to enterprise data governance frameworks, digital transformation strategy, and process optimization.

ICS Student Council | OIVP Crisis Management Staff
Aug 2024 – May 2025
• Facilitated student support operations, department communications, and crisis management initiatives.

PROJECTS

Twitch SQLite Data Analysis | Data Analytics & SQL
• Executed complex SQL queries and relational database analysis on Twitch streaming data stored in SQLite to uncover user engagement patterns, streaming behavior, and platform metrics.

Steam Power Bi Database Dashboard | Data Visualization & Analytics
• Designed and built an interactive Power BI database dashboard parsing Steam 2025 kaggle dataset to aggregate and visualize valuable KPI metrics and performance trends.

Amazon BeautifulSoup Scraper | Python Web Scraping Pipeline
• Developed an automated web scraping pipeline in Python using BeautifulSoup (scraper.py) to extract, cleanse, and structure Amazon Bestsellers product data directly into CSV format.

Tagalog-AI Ensemble Model | ML Lead - Undergraduate Thesis
• Developed an end-to-end Tagalog NLP pipeline combining OpenAI Whisper ASR and Tagalog RoBERTa for context-aware speech recognition and translation.

Payroll Management System | FullStack Developer - ARCO
• Engineered a desktop payroll app using Python, Tkinter, and SQLite to automate weekly salary processing and generate instant PDF financial summaries via ReportLab.

Dental Book Mobile App | FullStack Developer - CAC Dental
• Developed a cross-platform Flutter app featuring real-time Google Calendar API schedule synchronization and a secure patient record database.

AiB Banking App | Front End Developer - BPI Hackathon
• Prototyped a responsive banking dashboard featuring a custom Savings Goal Predictor, AI chatbot simulation, and dynamic transaction filtering.

Truck-In-N-Out Logistics System | Front End Developer
• Designed and implemented responsive front-end user interface modules for a capstone logistics tracking dashboard.
applications.geminiRationale: The candidate is a current undergraduate student with internship-level experience, lacking the extensive professional background, distributed computing expertise, and production-scale LLM deployment experience required for a Lead Architect role.

JORDAN HAYES
Senior Full Stack Developer
jordan.hayes@example.com | +1 (555) 234-5678 | San Francisco, CA

SUMMARY
Accomplished Full Stack Software Engineer with 6+ years of specialized experience designing and maintaining high-throughput web applications using React, TypeScript, Node.js, and relational databases. Strong focus on clean architecture, component reusability, and automated testing.

- Led a squad of 5 engineers delivering high-performance customer dashboard.
- Re-architected legacy backend services into modular Node.js REST APIs.
- Built real-time WebSocket notifications and data pipelines.

Full Stack Developer - NextGen Systems (2019 - 2022)
- Created dynamic React components and optimized client bundle sizes.
- Authored unit and integration test suites achieving 88% coverage.

B.S. in Computer Science - University of California, Berkeley (2019)

SKILLS
React, Node.js, Express, JavaScript, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, TailwindCSS, Docker, CI/CD, Jest
applications.geminiRationale: Exceptional match. Candidate boasts 6+ years of direct React and Node.js expertise with proven architectural leadership and cloud delivery.

interview.notes: Prepare to discuss REST API decoupling and React state caching.

applications.recruiterNotes: Candidate demonstrated strong technical communication in the initial screening. Impressed by their system design experience.

evaluation.comments: Excellent culture fit, depth in Node and React architecture.
